# bintables/print

> print: write the value and a newline to stdout with the write syscall.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/print.pkg) · translates [std/print](../std/print.md)

Support routines are included once if `print` is used:

- `__pk_print_int` converts `rax` to decimal in a stack buffer (handling
  the sign and the most negative value) and writes it with one syscall;
  `u8` values print as numbers through it too;
- `__pk_print_str` writes a length-prefixed string, then the newline;
- `__pk_print_bool` writes `true` or `false`.

The variant is chosen from the value's type.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when value str`

```nasm
{value}
call __pk_print_str
```

### `emit when value bool`

```nasm
{value}
call __pk_print_bool
```

### `emit`

```nasm
{value}
call __pk_print_int
```

## Support code (once per program)

```nasm
__pk_print_int:
sub rsp, 40
lea rsi, [rsp+32]
mov byte [rsi], 10
mov r8, rax
mov rcx, rax
neg rcx
cmovl rcx, rax
mov rax, rcx
mov r9, 10
.digit:
xor edx, edx
div r9
add dl, 48
dec rsi
mov [rsi], dl
test rax, rax
jnz .digit
test r8, r8
jns .write
dec rsi
mov byte [rsi], 45
.write:
lea rdx, [rsp+33]
sub rdx, rsi
mov eax, 1
mov edi, 1
syscall
add rsp, 40
ret
__pk_print_str:
mov rdx, [rax]
lea rsi, [rax+8]
mov eax, 1
mov edi, 1
syscall
push 10
mov eax, 1
mov edi, 1
mov rsi, rsp
mov edx, 1
syscall
add rsp, 8
ret
__pk_print_bool:
lea rsi, [rel __pk_true]
mov edx, 5
test rax, rax
jnz .write
lea rsi, [rel __pk_false]
mov edx, 6
.write:
mov eax, 1
mov edi, 1
syscall
ret
section .data
__pk_true: db "true", 10
__pk_false: db "false", 10
section .text
```
